set.explanation: PMI's 2017 research found organizations with a strategy-aligned enterprise PMO report 38% more projects meeting their original goals — the opposite conclusion.

edits.claim: quiz option explanation: PMO organizations complete 38% more projects on time and budget
edits.src: PMI Pulse of the Profession 2017 "Success Rates Rise": organizations aligning their EPMO to strategy report 38% more projects meeting original goals and business intent (not PMO vs none, on time/budget)

expect.question: According to PMI's Pulse of the Profession research, what happens to organizations that treat project management as a non-strategic function?

set.explanation: PMI's 2020 Pulse of the Profession found organizations that undervalue project management as a strategic competency report an average of 67% more of their projects failing outright — treating execution discipline as optional carries a measurable, large penalty.

edits.src: PMI Pulse of the Profession 2020 "Ahead of the Curve": 67% more projects failing outright where PM is undervalued as a strategic competency
